evidence: TiS2 films were deposited in a custom-made hot wall viscous flow reactor using titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4) and hydrogen sulﬁde (H2S) within the temperature range of 75–250 /C14 C. A continuous flow of 350 sccm of high purity N2 gas was maintained through the reactor to keep the reactor base pressure constant at ca. 1 Torr.
